newsitem.title: USA: Volunteer Capital completes Wendy's sale.
newsitem.headline: Volunteer Capital completes Wendy's sale.

text.p: Volunteer Capital Corp said on Friday it has completed the sale of substantially all of the assets of its Wendy's franchised restaurant division to Wendy's International Inc for about $28 million in cash.
Volunteer Capital said it used about $12.5 million of the proceeds from the sale to pay off the outstanding balance on its line of credit agreement.
It said it expects to use the remaining amount, after expenses, to fund a significant portion of its capital expenditures related to the J. Alexander's restaurants currently under development.
